rows.label: bf08280100_0010
rows.name:
We're climbing up the World Tree, mo?
Sounds like hard work, mo.

rows.label: bf08280100_0020
rows.name:
It's shorter than the section that rises
from the Cloud Sea into the sky.

rows.label: bf08280100_0030
rows.name: We can handle that much.

rows.label: bf08280100_0040
rows.name: You're always so positive, aren't you?

rows.label: bf08280100_0050
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]へへへ[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf08280100_0060
rows.name: Rex.

rows.label: bf08280100_0070
rows.name:
I understand what led to this,
but I still can't just let him go.

rows.label: bf08280100_0080
rows.name: Meleph!

rows.label: bf08280100_0090
rows.name: Figured you'd say that.

rows.label: bf08280100_0100
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ][ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf08280100_0110
rows.name:
I don't expect you to
beg for forgiveness,

rows.label: bf08280100_0120
rows.name:
But once we're out of here,
I'll be taking you into custody.

rows.label: bf08280100_0130
rows.name:
I owe that much to my
emperor and our people.

rows.label: bf08280100_0140
rows.name: And if you refuse...

rows.label: bf08280100_0150
rows.name: You understand, Kagutsuchi?

rows.label: bf08280100_0160
rows.name: Yes.

rows.label: bf08280100_0170
rows.name: Meleph!

rows.label: bf08280100_0180
rows.name:
What? More monsters? Where
are they coming from now?

rows.label: bf08280100_0190
rows.name: No, mo! It's above us, mo!

rows.label: bf08280100_0200
rows.name: Monoceros... You mean they found Shin?
